name: Super Sushi Samurai stale-balance self-transfer inflation
summary: The token's custom _update() read the recipient balance before reducing the sender balance. When sender and recipient were equal, its final recipient write overwrote the reduction with the stale balance plus the transfer amount, doubling the account's balance on every self-transfer.

loss.notes: The linked campaign first paid 0.010000000000000000 WETH into the SSS/WETH pair, then the cash-out receipt transferred 1,310.040494988573740722 WETH from that pair with zero WETH returned. Gross victim depletion net of the linked input is therefore 1,310.040494988573740722 - 0.010000000000000000 = 1,310.030494988573740722 WETH. The cash-out also delivered 4,954,444,444,444,439 SSS to the pair, exactly matching its same-block archive increase; this unbacked consideration is retained by the victim and is not a second loss component. Unrelated market activity between the setup purchase and cash-out reduced pair WETH by 109.408357782325449417 and is excluded. The later 1,244.66 WETH whitehat return is recovery and is not netted from exploit-time gross loss. A separate reported 40.28 WETH blackhat campaign is outside this sender/helper boundary. The 103-second-preceding ETH price is 3,526.16 USD.

ageReset.description: The stale-balance _update logic is part of the token's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

sources.note: Archive-RPC review bounded one linked whitehat campaign. Sender nonce 0 bought SSS with exactly 0.01 WETH; nonce 1 created the helper; nonce 2 moved the purchased SSS into it; nonce 3 and the recipient's return transaction establish custody linkage; nonce 4 made the first defective self-transfer calls; nonce 5 cashed out the pair; and nonce 6 moved the WETH to the linked recipient. Pair WETH was 1,448.948886786028391015 before the setup purchase, 1,448.958886786028391015 after it, 1,339.550529003702941598 immediately before cash-out, and 29.510034015129200876 after cash-out. Thus the receipt's ten WETH outflows exactly explain the 1,310.040494988573740722 same-block archive delta; the intervening 109.408357782325449417-WETH market decline is unrelated and excluded. Pair SSS increased by exactly the receipt's 4,954,444,444,444,439-SSS input during cash-out. The helper then transferred the WETH to the linked recipient; a later 1,244.66-WETH return is recovery, while the separate 40.28-WETH blackhat campaign uses a different actor and is excluded. The first defect receipt is 48 seconds before cash-out, so it remains the incident anchor. The SSS token is a direct contract created at 570927:3; code is absent at 570926 and the 11,280-byte runtime hash 0xa8fff26c4cd91901e875f739abd473d6374ebb996cd92e317131b892ecbb0e2e is unchanged at the incident, with no delegation or destruction path. Its age at the first defect is 1,080,976 seconds. DefiLlama's ETH observation at 1711032590 is 55 seconds before that anchor and 103 seconds before cash-out.
